description:
﻿APPLICATION FOR VARIATION OF CONDITION 2 (DRAWING
NUMBERS) RELATING TO LBM PLANNING PERMISSION 20/P3168 - ERECTION OF A SINGLE
STOREY ROOF EXTENSION AND INFILL EXTENSION FOR THE CREATION OF 5 SELF CONTAINED
FLATS TOGETHER WITH ASSOCIATED AMENITY AREAS, CYCLE PARKING, REFUSE AREAS AND ASSOCIATED WORKS.

THE VARIATION SEEKS TO SUB-DIVIDE THE APPROVED THREE
BEDROOM FLAT (FLAT 1) INTO A 1 X 2B/4P UNIT AND 1 X 1B/1P UNIT, INCREASING THE
OVERALL NUMBER OF FLATS FROM 5 TO 6.

<p style="text-align: justify; "><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Opening over Highway</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;"> - The doors of the garage or gates hereby approved

following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies T4 and T7 of the

<p style="text-align: justify; "><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Cycle Parking to be implemented</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;"> - The development hereby permitted shall

are provided and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for
Merton: policy T5 of the London Plan 2021 and policies T16.1 and T16.2 of the
Local Plan 2024.</span></span><o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; "><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Working Method Statement </span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">- Development shall not commence
until a working method statement has been submitted to and approved in writing
by the Local Planning Authority to accommodate:</span><o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="line-height: 107%; font-size: 14px;">&nbsp;</span><span style="font-size: 14px;">&nbsp; (i) Parking of
vehicles of site workers and visitors;</span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="line-height: 107%;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">&nbsp;&nbsp; (ii) Delivery
times;</span><o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="line-height: 107%;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">&nbsp;&nbsp; (iii) Loading and
unloading of plant and materials;</span><o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="line-height: 107%;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">&nbsp;&nbsp; (iv) Storage of
construction plant and materials;</span><o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="line-height: 107%;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">&nbsp;&nbsp; (v) Wheel cleaning
facilities</span><o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="line-height: 107%;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">&nbsp;&nbsp; (vi) Control of
dust, smell and other effluvia;</span><o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="line-height: 107%;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">&nbsp;&nbsp; (vii) Control of
surface water run-off.</span><o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="line-height: 107%; font-size: 14px;">&nbsp;</span><span style="font-size: 14px;">No development shall
be carried out except in full accordance with the approved method statement.</span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">Alternatively, the development can be carried out in accordance with the Working Method Statement submitted under condition discharge application 24/P2162.</span></p><p><span style="line-height: 107%;"></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Reason</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">: To ensure the safety of pedestrians and vehicles
and the amenities of the surrounding area and to comply with the following
Development Plan policies for Merton: policies T4 and T7 of the London Plan
2021 and policies T16.3 and T16.4 of the Local Plan 2024.</span></span><o:p></o:p></p>

<p style="text-align: justify; "><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Construction Logistics Plan</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;"> - Prior to the commencement of the
development hereby permitted, including demolition, a Construction Logistics

Authority.&nbsp; The approved measures shall
be adhered to throughout the construction process, unless the prior written
approval of the Local Planning Authority is first obtained to any variation.</span></span></p><p style="text-align: justify; "><span style="line-height: 107%;"><span style="font-size:11.0pt;font-family:&quot;Aptos&quot;,sans-serif;

and the amenities of the surrounding area and to comply with the following
Development Plan policies for Merton: policies T4 and T7 of the London Plan
2021 and policies T16.3 and T16.4 of the Local Plan 2024.</span></span><o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; "><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
" arial",sans-serif"=""><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Materials to be Approved</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;"> - No development shall take place
until details of particulars and samples of the materials to be used on all
external faces of the development hereby permitted, including window frames and
doors (notwithstanding any materials specified in the application form and/or
the approved drawings), have been submitted to the Local Planning Authority for
approval. No works which are the subject of this condition shall be carried out
until the details are approved, and the development shall be carried out in
full accordance with the&nbsp;</span></span><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px;">approved details.</span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; "><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px;">Alternatively, the development can be carried out in accordance with the materials agreed under condition discharge application 24/P2162.</span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;
font-family:" arial",sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:aptos;mso-fareast-theme-font:="" minor-latin;mso-ansi-language:en-gb;mso-fareast-language:en-us;mso-bidi-language:="" ar-sa"=""><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Reason</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">: To ensure a satisfactory appearance of the development and to
comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies D4 and
D8 of the London Plan 2021, policies D12.1 and D12.3 of the Local Plan 2024 .</span></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; "><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Sustainable Drainage</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;"> -&nbsp;</span></span><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">No
development approved by this permission shall be commenced until a detailed
scheme for the provision of surface and foul water drainage has been
implemented in accordance with details that have been submitted to and approved
in writing by the local planning authority. The drainage scheme will dispose of
surface water by means of a sustainable drainage system (SuDS) via infiltration
or at an agreed runoff rate, in accordance with drainage hierarchy contained
within the London Plan and the advice contained within the National SuDS
Standards.</span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; "><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><br></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; "><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Alternatively, the development shall be carried out in accordance with the drainage plan agreed under condition discharge application 24/P2162.</span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:
&quot;MS Mincho&quot;;mso-font-kerning:0pt;mso-ligatures:none;mso-fareast-language:JA"><o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Reason</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">: To ensure satisfactory means of surface water
drainage, to reduce the risk of flooding and to comply with the following
Development Plan policies for Merton: policy SI 13 of the London Plan 2021 and
policies F15.7, F15.8 and F15.9 of the Local Plan 2024.</span></span><o:p></o:p></p><p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:" arial",sans-serif;="" mso-fareast-font-family:aptos;mso-fareast-theme-font:minor-latin;mso-ansi-language:="" en-gb;mso-fareast-language:en-us;mso-bidi-language:ar-sa"=""><br></span></p>

<p style="text-align: justify; "><span style="font-size: 14px;">﻿</span><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Delivery and Servicing Plan</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;"> - Development shall not commence until a
Delivery and Servicing Plan (the Plan) has been submitted in writing for
approval to the Local Planning Authority. No occupation of the development
shall be permitted until the Plan is approved in writing by the Local Planning
Authority and implemented in accordance with the approved plan.&nbsp; The approved measures shall be maintained, in
accordance with the Plan, for the duration of the use, unless the prior written
approval of the Local Planning Authority is obtained to any variation.</span></span></p><p style="text-align: justify; "><span style="line-height: 107%;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">Alternatively, the development can be carried out in accordance with the Delivery and Servicing Plan agreed under condition discharge application 24/P2162.</span></span></p><p><span style="line-height: 107%;"></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Reason</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">: To ensure the safety of pedestrians and vehicles
and the amenities of the surrounding area and to comply with the following
Development Plan policies for Merton: policies T4 and T7 of the London Plan
2021 and policy T16.4 of the Local Plan 2024.</span></span><o:p></o:p></p>

<p style="text-align: justify; "><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Sustainability -&nbsp;</span></u></span><span style="font-size: 11pt;">No part of the development hereby approved shall be occupied until evidence has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority confirming that the residential development has achieved CO2 reductions in accordance with those outlined in the submitted Merton energy assessment template and wholesome water consumption rates of no greater than 105 litres per person per day.</span></p><br data-cke-eol="1"><p><span style="line-height: 107%;"></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Reason</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">: To ensure that the development achieves a high
standard of sustainability and makes efficient use of resources and to comply
with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: Policy SI 2 and SI 3
of the London Plan 2021 and Policies CC2.1, CC2.2, CC2.3, CC2.4, CC2.5 and CC2.6
of the Local Plan 2024.</span></span><o:p></o:p></p>
